summary: This topic describes the availability of various fee reports, such as daily collection, combined daily collection, and due fee reports, along with filtering options to analyze student payment statuses and outstanding amounts.
steps: Navigate to the 'Fee Reports' section within the 'Fee' module.
Select the desired report type (e.g., 'Daily Fee Report', 'Due Fee Report', 'Combined Daily Collection').
Apply relevant filters such as class, stream, batch, date range, 'show student with zero dues', or 'awake status' (active/defaulted students).
Generate the report and export it, typically to Excel, for further analysis.
business_rules: Filtering options are available in every report section to refine data.
important_notes: The 'Show student with zero dues' filter: Selecting 'No' will display only students with pending dues, while 'Yes' will show all students regardless of dues.
The 'Awake status' filter: Setting it to 'False' will list only defaulted students (those who have not paid for a particular session).
Amount-wise filtering is not currently available for fee reports but can be requested as a future enhancement.
